direction: Calm, warm, confident educator. One continuous read, conversational pace (~150 wpm). Let sentences run into each other; small natural breaths, no robotic gaps. Slight lift on 'Now watch', settle down on the key line.

lines.text: The SA node fires, the atria squeeze, then the signal passes through the AV node and both ventricles squeeze.
Now watch what happens in A-fib.
The atria no longer squeeze. They just quiver, firing hundreds of chaotic signals a minute.
The AV node lets only some of them through, so the heartbeat becomes irregularly irregular.
If the patient is unstable, use synchronized cardioversion. If stable, slow the rate and think about stroke risk.
Practice it on ACLSMED Sim. ACLSmed dot com.
